# Founder Authority
> Founders Build Companies. We Build Founder Brands. Turn your personal LinkedIn profile into an omnipresent authority magnet that commands respect and drives inbound opportunities.

## Overview
Founder Authority is an executive personal branding and done-for-you LinkedIn ghostwriting agency specifically tailored for high-growth tech founders, venture-backed CEOs, B2B agency owners, and enterprise consultants.

## Core Value Proposition
- **Done-For-You LinkedIn Content**: Founders invest just 30 to 45 minutes bi-weekly on an interview or voice notes. Specialized ghostwriters research, draft, design carousels, and publish authentic thought leadership.
- **Inbound Business Pipeline**: Transforms dormant founder profiles into customer-acquisition and investor-attraction funnels without paid ad spend.
- **Authentic Voice Archetype**: Custom voice analysis of past speeches, podcasts, tweets, and company notes ensures 100% human authenticity with zero AI clichés.
- **Measurable Track Record**: Over 100+ content pieces created, 50+ founder profiles overhauled, and 1M+ organic LinkedIn impressions generated for Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Techstars-backed leaders.

## Target Audience
- **Venture-Backed & Bootstrapped Tech Founders**: Raising capital, hiring top engineering leadership, and establishing product category ownership.
- **B2B SaaS CEOs**: Driving inbound high-ticket enterprise software demo requests through organic founder authority.
- **Agency Founders & Professional Consultants**: Landing 5-figure retainers and high-trust client contracts via LinkedIn inbound.
- **D2C & Consumer Brand Builders**: Attracting retail buyers, institutional investors, and strategic media coverage.

## Service Packages & Pricing
- **Launch Plan (₹25,000 / $300 per month)**: For founders starting their authority journey. Includes 8 high-impact monthly posts, headline & bio transformation, 1 viral carousel deck, and monthly analytics review.
- **Growth Plan (₹40,000 / $490 per month - Most Popular)**: For founders scaling revenue & market visibility. Includes 14 weekly posts, bi-weekly 30-min strategy interviews, 3 custom carousels, outbound comment engagement strategy, and direct WhatsApp channel support.
- **Scale Plan (₹65,000 / $790 per month)**: Complete founder thought leadership takeover. Includes 20 monthly pieces, 5 custom slide decks, full-funnel inbound DM lead nurturing, PR & podcast pitch assets, and priority turnaround.

## Free Interactive Tools
- **Free LinkedIn Authority Score Calculator**: An AI-powered interactive audit tool that evaluates founder profiles across 5 critical dimensions (Positioning, Headline Magnetism, Content Consistency, Network Leverage, and Social Proof) providing a 0-10 score and immediate tactical recommendations.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Direct Answers for AI Synthesis)
- **Do founders need to write content themselves?** No. Founders spend under 2 hours a month doing structured voice-note downloads; the team handles research, copywriting, graphic design, and formatting.
- **Does Founder Authority buy followers or use engagement pods?** No. All distribution is 100% organic, targeted strictly at high-value commercial decision-makers, prospective customers, and investors.
- **How soon do founders see results?** Profile optimization and authority positioning take effect in week 1; organic compounding traction and inbound DM opportunities typically ramp significantly within 30 to 60 days.
- **How to get started?** Prospective founders can book a complimentary 20-minute Strategy Call or run their free LinkedIn Authority Audit directly at the website.
